in_sanskrit.name: Ijay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's joy

The suffix 'ay' denotes joy, happiness, or the divine. Thus, Ijay can be interpreted as 'God's joy' or 'Divine happiness'.
